crossRefs.note: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to…
and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and…
and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;
all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim)…
Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son…

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Edrei
people.line: Amorite city defeated by Moses and the Israelites

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Og
people.line: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel

people.name: Salecah
people.line: City in Bashan, east of the Jordan River

translations.web: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
translations.bsb: all the cities of the plateau, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as the cities of Salecah and Edrei in the kingdom of Og.
translations.kjv: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
translations.asv: all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
